contentHtml:
New Delhi: Indian drugmaker Mankind Pharma reported an over 39% jump in second-quarter profit on ​Monday, helped by strong demand for ‌chronic therapies such as diabetes and cardiac treatments,

Here are the details:

  • Consolidated net profit rose to 7.11 ​billion rupees ($74.7 million) for the quarter ​ended September 30, from 5.12 billion rupees ⁠a year earlier.
  • Mankind Pharma , opens new tab and peers ​including Torrent Pharma, opens new tab continue to benefit from ​strong demand for chronic therapies, particularly diabetes and cardiovascular treatments, helping drive steady growth in the domestic ​formulations business.
  • Its domestic revenue, excluding the consumer ​healthcare business, climbed 16% to 34.28 billion rupees, led ‌by ⁠a 19% growth in its cardiac segment and a 16% climb in its anti-diabetes segment.
  • This boosted overall revenue by 17.3% to ​43.38 billion ​rupees.
  • Mankind Pharma ⁠makes prescription medicines across chronic and acute therapies, and consumer ​healthcare products including Manforce condoms, Prega ​News ⁠pregnancy test kits and Gas-O-Fast antacid tablets.
  • Last week, peer Torrent Pharma , opens new tab reported a near 10% drop ⁠in ​quarterly profit as R&D ​costs outweighed strong domestic demand.

Source : Reuters
